newsitem.title: USA: Alliant Tech finishes subsystems testing.
newsitem.headline: Alliant Tech finishes subsystems testing.

text.p: Alliant Techsystems Inc, an aerospace and defense company, said Friday it has finished testing three key Outrider Tactical Unmanned Aerial Vehicle subsystems.
The company said the tests involved the following systems: the C-band data link, the electro-optic/infrared payload control, and a new engine that has been integrated into an air vehicle.

"We verified data link performance at over 200 kilometers, a critical U.S. Navy requirement, with good imagery transmitted from that distance," Hugo Fruehauf, group vice president defense systems, said in a statement.

"Testing also demonstrated the capability of handing off the air vehicle from one ground control station to another, verifying the flexibility needed for supporting tactical military operations. The payload is now ready for final system integration," he added.
